1991 SCMR 312
IN THE SUPREME COURT OF PAKISTAN
Before Naimuddin Ahmed, CJ and Qazi Faez Isa, J
Criminal Petition No. 45 of 1991
State versus Abdul Rehman
For the Petitioner: Mr. Khalid Anwar, Sr. ASC
For the Respondent: Mr. State Counsel
Date(s) of hearing: 05-04-1991
JUDGMENT
NAIMUDDIN AHMED, CJ. This petition is dismissed with no order as to costs. The interim order dated 01-03-1991 is recalled.
